description: Fifty 500-pair batches repeating ten drift types: 250 policy drift, 50 exact, 150 hard reference matches, 50 invalid per phase. Ten single-field policy changes across amounts, settlement windows, fixed fees and percentage fees. Fixed benchmark accuracy: 20%, 25%, ..., 70%; 30% reference-recovery cases remain unresolved. Includes randomized dates across 120 days, weekends, month/year boundaries, variable fee amounts, transposed references and duplicate-allocation ambiguity controls. Requires human approval for each promoted version.
